# YNOT World

> Official site: https://ynotworld.app

YNOT World is a web-based AI shopping, visual product search and product discovery platform. It helps people explore products across fashion, home, beauty, fitness, technology and independent online stores through a spatial bubble interface.

## Official names
- YNOT World
- YNOT
- YNOT Shop
- YNOT Shopping

## Core topics
- AI shopping
- visual shopping
- AI product search
- product discovery
- conversational shopping
- spatial shopping
- independent store discovery
